title: E&O Insurance for Startups
summary: What Tech E&O covers, how to match a quote to customer contracts, and what startups should check for Cyber, AI, limits and claims-made coverage.
body_markdown:
We help you work through coverage for the product you sell and the contracts you sign. Our


[Tech E&O options](https://www.corgi.insure/tech-eo) address development, integration and data migration, with an extension available for subcontracted technology services.


If you build with AI, we offer a modular AI endorsement so you can select the protection your product needs. AI-related claims are excluded from the standard policy; each selected module has its own limit and retention. Our


[Tech E&O and AI guide](https://www.corgi.insure/blog/does-tech-eo-cover-ai) explains what to review with your quote.


That practical help matters when procurement is holding up a signature. Eragon founder Josh Sirota describes how we handled the policies, limits and certificates for an enterprise deal that closed in days.


[Read Eragon's story](https://www.corgi.insure/customers/eragon) .


Send us your customer's insurance clause, a short description of your product and your deadline. We can review Tech E&O and Cyber together and work through the details with you before you buy.


[Talk to Corgi](https://www.corgi.insure/book-a-demo) .
